@returns The value of an environment variable, or an empty string when it is not set.

```blitzbasic
;run
SetEnv "WIKI_EXAMPLE", "hello"
Print GetEnv$("WIKI_EXAMPLE")
```

```text
hello
```
@param env_var  The name of the variable.
